nom: Drunk Elephant Lala Retro Whipped Cream Moisturizer with Ceramides

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin describe the cream as richer than what they'd normally choose but report it doesn't clog pores or cause breakouts, working well as a night cream or in colder months.
segments.dry: The largest group of reviewers, with dry skin, report the whipped texture is deeply hydrating, absorbs without greasiness, and relieves tightness, flaking and dullness, especially in winter; one reviewer found it not moisturizing enough for her dry skin.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers, including those leaning dry or with oily and dry zones together, say it balances their skin and doesn't leave oily areas greasy.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive and eczema-prone reviewers generally report the cream is gentle, fragrance-free and calming with no irritation, though one sensitive-skin reviewer experienced increased dryness, irritation and a compromised barrier.
segments.mature: One reviewer in her mid-30s using anti-aging products reports the cream keeps dehydration lines hydrated for hours and supports her barrier.
segments.normal: One reviewer notes that people with naturally oily-to-normal skin may tolerate the formula with no adverse reaction, in contrast to her own dry, sensitive skin.

concerns.aging: One reviewer with mid-30s skin and dehydration lines reports the cream keeps her skin hydrated for hours and supports her barrier; another with mild pigmentation says her tone looks more even.
concerns.dehydration: Many reviewers across skin types report significant relief from dryness and dehydration, describing plumper, softer, more comfortable skin; one reviewer found it insufficiently moisturizing for her dry skin and another reports it worsened her dryness.
concerns.redness: Reviewers dealing with redness report the cream calmed and soothed their skin without irritation, including one who says it helped with active breakouts and redness simultaneously.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers report the cream helped restore or protect a compromised moisture barrier, citing the ceramide content; one reviewer, however, says her barrier became more compromised, with irritation and inflammation, after a few weeks of use.
concerns.spots: One reviewer with mild pigmentation reports her skin tone looks a bit more even after use; this concern is otherwise rarely addressed.
concerns.blemishes: Most acne-prone reviewers report no new breakouts and describe it as non-comedogenic for them, with one specifically noting it soothed active breakouts; however, one reviewer reports a severe breakout after daily use, and another warns the formula contains a comedogenic ingredient that may be risky for acne-prone skin.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers report the cream feels rich but not suffocating and does not leave a greasy film, describing it as more suited to cooler months than hot summer days.

aspects.libelle: Whipped, rich texture that absorbs quickly
Pump mechanism malfunctioning on some units
High price relative to jar size
Layers well under makeup and SPF

extraits.texte: Not safe for acne prone skin. This caused me a severe acne breakout a few days after using this daily.

I had high hopes for this moisturizer, but after trying it and researching the ingredients, I have to say that this product is a pass on my list. I used it for a few weeks, and during that time my skin became irritated, even more dry than it was to begin with, and inflamed. My skin barrier most definitely became compromised. If you have naturally dry, sensitive skin, I would avoid this one. Ingredients in it that can be problematic for people with skin like mine include the following: phenoxyethanol, chlorphenesin, ceteareth‑20, sodium hydroxide, and citric acid. People with naturally oily to "normal" skin may have no adverse reactions to this product, but my naturally dry skin has some healing to do after trying it for a few weeks. I will say that the pump and packaging are nice, but I hope that Drunk Elephant reevaluates the ingredients they're using.

Lately my skin has been going through a rough phase with dryness, redness, barrier damage and breakouts,so finding something gentle has been important.This moisturizer has been the one I keep reaching for because it feels soothing and doesn't irritate my skin.The formula has a whipped cream texture that spreads easily and feels light while still providing enough hydration.I haven't noticed any itching or discomfort.The packaging is practical and looks nice too.After application my skin looks calmer and a bit more radiant with a healthy glow. I received this product complimentary from Drunk Elephant.

extraits.titre: Not the best for acne-prone skin
extraits.texte: I received this complimentary from Drunk Elephant in exchange for my honest review. I really like the packaging of this moisturizer and that is refillable. It's a very thick and hydrating texture. However, if you are acne-prone, I would be careful using this daily as the fourth ingredient (Isopropyl Isostearate) is highly comedogenic.

I got a sample size while i was on vacation and used up every last bit of it and bought a full sized one and used up all of that as well. I hace horrible combo skin, very very oily skin on top of my cheeks, nose and the middle of my forehead and dry skin everywhere else, this is the only moisturizer that makes my skin feel even. Recommend this 100%

My skin has been ridiculously thirsty lately and the way my dehydration lines have been drinking this up… unreal. Mid-30s skin plus a routine full of anti-aging products means my barrier can be a little dramatic sometimes. I really like the whipped texture. It feels rich and cushiony but still melts in nicely and keeps my skin feeling hydrated for hours instead of disappearing after an hour. The ceramides for barrier support are a nice bonus, and it's been getting along with the rest of my routine which, if you know… you know. Also love the air-tight pump situation. No dipping fingers into a jar and everything stays fresh. And the fact that it's refillable is a win because I'd rather keep the juicy grape skin without buying a whole new pile of plastic every time. . gifted by drunkelephant

I'm officially on my second jar of this Drunk Elephant moisturizer! I'm obsessed with its airy, lightweight texture and how effortlessly it melts into my skin. Every morning, I wake up to a noticeably dewy, hydrated glow. Most importantly, it's been a lifesaver for calming my redness and soothing active breakouts. Gifted by drunk elephant.
